title: Read a selected assessment with its explanation and scope
actor: A reviewer preparing to assess recorded engineering work
goal: Obtain the requested recorded assessment and its explanation with enough scope and state information to understand what was read.
context: The reviewer needs one selected assessment rather than all records and unrelated diagnostic detail. The selected assessment may be retained in local history independently of the current model.
trigger: The reviewer requests one selected Review or Verification.
preconditions: The change and intended assessment are explicitly selected.

interaction.action: Requests the selected assessment using its owning Change and item ID.
Returns its complete current content, revision, support standing and explicit gaps.
Reads the supplied explanation in the requested human or machine projection and independently judges whether further information is needed.

expected_outcome: The reviewer receives the requested recorded meaning without unrelated bodies, invented reasoning, hidden omissions, or a claim that retrieval completeness establishes assessment adequacy.

alternatives.condition: A prepared Review has no assessment yet.
A supporting payload or current assessment dependency is unavailable.
alternatives.outcome: Preserve the recorded conclusion and show the reliance gap without inventing support.

failures.condition: The selected registered report is missing, malformed, unsafe, unreadable, or outside the supported format.
failures.outcome: The system reports the specific condition rather than suggesting an empty or nonexistent assessment.

failures.condition: The requested content cannot fit the permitted output bound.
failures.outcome: Report the bounded read failure before partial output; do not truncate the selected account.

failures.condition: The assessment exists but required retained evidence is unavailable.
failures.outcome: Recorded explanation and retrieval scope remain distinct from evidence availability; no complete supported assessment is inferred.
